violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Food contact surface of utensil/equipment was not properly cleaned and sanitized. Ice scoop was being held in a bucket that had debris and dead insects in it.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Boxes of single service items were being stored on the floor in the dry storage.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Cardboard containers on top of the oven are not a nonabsorbent cleanable surface.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. Boxes of single-use item stored on the floor of the dry storage area.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors underneath the kitchen equipment need to be cleaned.
Clean dry location, protected (1 pt deducted)
Number, location, accessibility, soap and paper towels provided (3 pts deducted)
